reviews.text: I recently had to put down my baby, it’s never an easy process. The staff here was very sweet and kind through all steps of the process. They helped me cut some of his hair so that I can keep it with me. They packaged his ashes in a beautiful urn and mailed me a wonderful card where all the staff members gave their condolences. I can’t thank this place enough for helping put a smile on my face through such a difficult time. My little Panda 🤍🕊️🖤

I came here two weeks ago when my small dog started throwing up blood, and I was terrified. From the first phone call, everything was professional and smooth. The doctor was confident and reassuring, gave us options without pushing unnecessary tests or treatments, and made me feel like my dog was in good hands.

Even after we left, I called around closing time because my dog threw up again, and the doctor personally called me back to reassure me and explain what to do. I followed the medication instructions, and within a couple of days my dog was doing so much better!

They’re caring, professional, and truly on top of everything. I’ll definitely be coming back for all of my pet’s needs!

Took my cat in with an appointment and even though they were running behind they never rushed me and answered all my questions. They were very attentive, friendly and knowledgeable. This is only the second time my cat has seen a doctor in 12 years and I would definitely come again.

We went there for a sad reason.  Our sweet 15 - 16 yr old pit stopped eating and was in need of help.  They checked him out, softly and swiftly and explained what was happening.  They helped him to transition.  I was crying from the moment I walked in as I knew what was coming and he was in so much pain.  It had happened quickly.  They were very considerate,  and treated him and us with all the kindness and empathy.  I would recommend Ren at the front desk, our vet tech Phebeo and our vet Dr Mina.  They made a sad situation a little bit more bearable.  Thank you for helping us at a very painful time.

Terrible service. Long wait time. Staff/vet is not very knowledgeable. Came in because my normal vet couldn’t see me sooner. My cat has a history of frequent UTIs, and predisposition confirmed on prior US. Told them my cat gets these symptoms before he gets worse and starts peeing blood and he needs antibiotics. But vet says he wont give them until results come back for another 2 days while my cat waits in pain and continues to be symptomatic. I told him the cat has a fever, he didn’t even check the temp. Honestly felt like he just didn’t want to give the meds.

We have been coming to 4 years with both of our dogs and always had good experience!
We lost our baby last month. This office is very caring and supportive. And made the process as comfortable as possible. ❤️

I've been taking my 2 dogs here for almost 2 years. Last Saturday I took my dog with a cough that was not normal.  Dr Hanna said decline the Xray because I know some dogs die at home after getting an x-ray when in distress . My dog had collapsed traquea.  OK I declined.  Sunday I left home for 2 hours and my dog died suffocated with her cough after I looked at the cameras inside. Maybe she had fluid in her lung. Then I found out  that most places give a dog sedative for xray if they're coughing and this wasn't not offered.  I also have a dog with diabetes that I took her this morning for fructosamine test.  The tech who's new, did the wrong test which this makes me believe that they're incompetent, and I guess they don't check the notes.  Imagine taking your dog to this place where a tech doesn't check and even wrong medication can be given. . I will report them to the better business bureau.  Dr Hanna said I'm sorry for your loss.  I should have known when he said to me dogs with diabetes don't lose hair which is common in dogs with diabetes when my dog was loosing hair. Its like saying dogs with diabetes don't drink more water and pee more. He's incompetent and he shouldn't be practicing. My dog died a week ago because of him. Shame on you and shouldn't practice. Also this place gives appointments and it doesn't matter.  You'll be there 2hours appointment or not
Why have appointments if you don’t honor them ? Avoid this vet they don’t value there customers times

Gave me a discount to give them a good review which I did. But in later visits, I was told to have a surgery for my dog that she didn't really need. She had a hard time recovering from this. So this is my real review not being given a discount for this review.

I Am so grateful  to the staff and vet form this hospital. We recently had our down our baby and everyone was very kind and nice.
Also, their prices are very affordable. Definitely recommended to all friends and family!
Very good veterinary spot.

Clinic care isn't why i'm leaving a negative review, it's the way the MALE receptionist spoke to me. I felt he was very rude and opinionated when speaking to him. Will NEVER come here and I hope he works on his phone etiquette because the way he spoke to me, an ex potential client was ridiculous. Astronomical how hard respect is to find. TWO BIG THUMBS DOWN!!!!

Absolutely horrible time management skills at this office. Every single time I’ve come here, they leave me & my dog in a room for over an hour after our appointment before I’m seen. Today I had “the first appointment” at 8:30 and the vet was supposed to see us first. It’s almost 9:30 and I’ve been in this exam room,
Not having seen anyone. I’ve just been told “the doctor will see you soon” twice.

This vet clinic is not a real clinic and the vets do not have real experience with emergency cases. My dog had heart failure and had fluid in her lungs. I panicked and called this clinic. They told me to come in and that it would cost 900 dollars to get in since it's an after hours emergency which I gladly agreed. They gave my dog a nebulizer and charged me 100s of more dollars. They also gave me meds to take home? Weird. Unfortunately, I didn't know what to do. My dog did not get better and passed away that night. They did not tell me what condition she was in. They were vague and clueless. It took me 2 years to write this review because I was so upset. Please don't take your pet here. Take your pet to a VCA McClave Animal hospital that right down the street. They charge you the same prices and they know what they're doing. Pet owners beware of this place!

I stopped going there last year. Rude front desk people. Abusive behaviors managers, told me their names are Tomas and Dante.

They were adding the damaged cans pet foods on the shelf to trick people buying them. I saw a mold in one broken can that I paid for and the manager Tomas, treated me with his abusive behaviors just because I was checking the can foods, to make sure they don't sell the broken moldy foods to me again.The vet Hana and the owner don't care about their costumers, they will empty your pockets, then kicking you out If you are not happy with their horrible service. Low knowledge and neglectful people.

I would not recommend this place!

Before driving over, I called and specifically asked what the exam fee would be. I told them I was only about 15 minutes away and was coming straight in. I arrived exactly when I said I would, and the price had suddenly changed. It felt like a classic bait-and-switch. If your pricing changes at a certain time, tell the customer when they’re on the phone and saying they are on the way, not after they’ve already arrived.

When I questioned it, the manager was unprofessional and unwilling to honor the price their own staff had quoted me just minutes earlier over the phone. There was no accountability and no attempt to make the situation right. I can easily afford the difference, but that’s not the point. I don’t appreciate being misled. I told them I was deeply disappointed with how they handled the situation and that I would be leaving an honest review. They didn’t seem to care at all. I genuinely feel bad for the owner if this is the level of customer service being provided.

The worst part was that my dog was sitting there in pain while we argued over something that should have been simple.I left and went to another veterinary clinic down the street, where my dog was seen within minutes and received excellent care.

If a business won’t stand behind the price they quote over the phone, it’s hard to trust them with anything more important. I imagine their final bill would have been ridiculous. Thankfully, I didn’t stay long enough to find out. I won’t be returning, and I hope this review saves someone else from wasting their time.

The doctors here doesn’t seem to care for the pet in my situation my dogs. I’ve been here several times and not once have any of the doctors actually came in petting the dog… not even getting on floor to get to know the dog before examining him.  It’s all business with them and how to get the most money out of this visit. In my last experience after I gave the consent to do some blood work and a radiograph they had me sit in the exam room for almost 3 hours waiting. They could’ve told me it’ll take some time and they will call me when he’s done.  This is unacceptable for a veterinary office to only think of money and themselves and not even think of the owner or the animal.
Always amazing with both my difficult dogs. All the vets and staff here are loving and caring with animals. They are all rockstars and I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else

Dr. Hanna is great, but unfortunately the front office experience has been very frustrating. The staff who answer the phones routinely place callers on hold and seem to forget about them. I called three separate times today and was on hold for about 20 minutes each time before eventually hanging up.

It's disappointing because it's difficult to find time to make these calls during the workday. A simple offer to take a message or call back would make a huge difference. Instead, I was repeatedly placed on hold with no follow-up. I hope the office can improve its phone management, as it doesn't reflect the quality of care Dr. Hanna provides.

went above and beyond for my senior cat! i am so grateful to this whole team, talked to me with care and kindness explained everything she needed for her health and got me actual answers about her health, i can sleep better at night knowing the full picture of her health now. Thank you all!
The wait time with an appointment is usually half an hour. The staff never acknowledge being late or apologize. I suggest you show up 30 mins late so you won't have to wait needlessly.

I will always be greatful with the veterinarian that save my cat's life. Also his concern for my cat meant to me the most. I recommend this urgen care for anyone that has a pet they're staff are so kind and the manager she is so kind and very caring. There's one thing I learn from this experience is always prepared your self financially because life can change in a blink of an eye. Thank you To the Veterinarian Mina Faltas.

Terrible pain management, lack of empathy, and awful customer service
We have been coming to this clinic for my dog’s entire life, and we always had patience with them, but this was the breaking point. I brought my dog here on Friday, and he cried during the entire appointment, where he was diagnosed with an ear infection. After getting the medicine, he left the clinic terrified and desperate to escape. Over the weekend, he developed acute ear pain. I called Monday morning at 9:27 AM and called again around 2:20 PM. On both occasions, we explained that my dog was in a lot of pain. The receptionist, Tomas, cut me off both times and told me to wait for a doctor's call, which never came. I called back at 5:58 PM and faced an arrogant attitude from that same person, being told that if I wanted my pet to be seen for his pain that day, I had to pay for a whole new emergency visit because Friday’s doctor wasn’t there. Tomas finally scheduled an actual appointment for me to bring him the next morning at 8:30 AM at no extra cost to see the original doctor.To be clear, he set up this official appointment for us—we were not walk-ins. Tomas was the one handling everything from the initial phone calls to our arrival at the clinic. I arrived exactly at 8:30 AM on Tuesday for our scheduled time with my dog still in visible pain. The waiting room was getting crowded, and they started passing other dogs ahead of us anyway. When I asked at 9:15 AM, they casually told me the doctor had arrived late. When I followed up again around 9:30 AM to stress that my dog was suffering, Tomas simply told me there was nothing they could do and walked away. The front desk staff was completely insensitive and unprofessional regarding a patient in pain. I decided to leave and find a different veterinarian who actually respects time and animal welfare. I absolutely do not recommend this place anymore.

Been going here for years. Last time my dog had an issue where his tail was clipped, they shaved the entirely wrong spot and diagnosed the wrong area. I called and they basically just gave me the walk around so I took care of it myself. It’s clear that the checkup I pay for is not even done or done poorly. Hours wait every appointment and long phone holds. Prices up. Hard to recommend with poor service and better prices around.

I don't usually post reviews but this place can't be recommended. They tried to charge my 87-year old father in law $4,500 for an unnecessary "three day observation" stay. No common sense. Unethical. Dog was perfectly fine 2 hours later. Ridiculous.

quite cheap, but the wait time for the doctor is ridiculous. having a set time appointment does not mean you’ll get seen right away. i’ve waited over an hour & a half just to see the doctor. it’s ridiculous

Brought in my baby (9 yr old american bully mix) for emergency care and she was  taken care of quickly . Dr Peter Hannah was great,  very informative.  The staff was all so helpful and really seem to care about all the pets. Prices are very reasonable. This is now my new Vet. Glad to have them.
The vets here are super kind and patient. I’m glad they take walk-ins and assist my pup when he was in need.
Vets are super nice and patient with my pup and I.

Charged just to look at my cat a hundred dollars, wanted to clean up the wound on my cat that was attack by. Raccoon and saw him up for only 1500, dollars.  Greatest deal ever.  Guy barely spoke English, when my sister ask how long the cat was going to stay there he said no more than 20 minutes.
Quick exams, details well explained, reasonable pricing.
Great service and reasonable prices. I'll be back and I'll tell everyone! 👏😊🐕 …
Great experience! Staff was very attentive and caring of Tarzan. Vet was friendly and thorough with his examination. I felt like my boy got the best care possible and our concerns were addressed.
I’ve always had a great experience at Pet Cure Vetenary! They’re always thorough and gentle with my dog. I highly recommend this place!

Our little kitty had to get surgery and they have been so wonderful from the initial visit, while she was with them , and up to recovery. They have been so helpful and supportive. I wouldn’t go elsewhere for their veterinary needs. Everyone’s so kind and caring. Highly recommend

Good place for dogs brought my puppie here
Good service good people

I have been coming to this office since 2021, and while I want to clarify that Dr. Hanna was always honest and compassionate, the rest of the practice has devolved into a cold, transactional factory. After my experience on March 14th, I will never set foot in this building again.

I called to make the agonizing, gut-wrenching decision to say a final goodbye to my dog. After being put on hold and then hung up on, I finally reached a staff member who was the definition of a heartless robot. While I was in the middle of a life-shattering crisis, this man treated me with a "car dealer" coldness that was frankly disgusting.

He actually had the audacity to tell me I “picked a horrible day” to come in because they were "so busy on Saturdays." Let me be very clear: Nobody "picks" the day their beloved pet dies. It is a tragedy, not an "inconvenience" for your weekend schedule. To be talked to like a nuisance during my most vulnerable moment is a shameful failure of basic human decency.

The fact that he only attempted to flip a switch and be "kind" once he realized I was a regular patient is even more insulting. Compassion shouldn't be a tiered service based on your database—it should be a requirement for the job. If you work in a veterinary office and can’t summon a shred of empathy for a grieving owner, you are in the wrong profession. You do not get to be a rude, inconsiderate robot when people are saying goodbye.

I found an amazing, truly compassionate vet elsewhere who handled this difficult time with the grace my dog deserved. I am moving all of my other pets to that practice and will never look back.

If you are looking for an ounce of empathy during a crisis, stay far away from this place.

I do not recommend this place for your pets.
I took my puppy in because her paw was swollen and was bleeding from a little corner. Turns out she had a fox tail. They removed the fox tail, but then afterwards my little girl developed necrosis. They asked me to take her in every few days for a check up without giving us any type of medication or explanation. The vet recommended me soak her paw in ESPON salt to reduce inflammation. Her paw was so swollen I then grew worried/ frustrated and took her to VCA and they recommended I go an emergency hospital because, at the time, they did not have emergency services. I took her to True Care for Pets and they confirmed she had necrosis and preformed surgery to remove the dead skin. It took 4-8 weeks for her paw to heal with honey patches and antibiotics.

Our new vet is VCA— I appreciate them elevating the seriousness of her paw!

I can’t express how grateful I am for Pure Vet Clinic. I had to make one of the hardest decisions for my little dog, and the entire team was incredibly compassionate and respectful. They took the time to explain everything to me clearly and gave me as much time as I needed without ever making me feel rushed.
I’m actually visiting from Canada, and during such a difficult moment they treated me with so much kindness and understanding. Their professionalism, empathy, and care truly meant the world to me.
If you’re in the LA area and looking for a veterinary clinic that genuinely cares about both pets and their owners, I highly recommend Pure Vet Clinic. Thank you again for your compassion

Worst customer service. I went to this place because of the google rating but my experience was nothing like that. I booked an appt that had to be rescheduled because I had to wait an hour passed my appt time because of an emergency, they rescheduled for the next day and I still had to wait a long time until I gave up. They didn’t even call me to avoid my trip there and save my time. Also when you call they pick up the phone and immediately put you on hold for over 10m (I hung up after that). So inconsiderate!! I wonder if the good reviews here are even real
Excellent attention, excellent service. The kindness and speed with which I was attended to was very pleasant. Thank you for providing the care my dog ​​needed.

First time pet owner and took my puppy here for his vaccines. Very friendly staff and informative. For not knowing what each thing is they provide great explanations and put you at ease. I’m definitely going to be completing all my puppy needs here. Definitely recommend coming here.very clean.  Best vet in SFV

They are so friendly and nice, duper awesome with my pup. Shes a little reactive and they were able to accommodate to my needs. They made sure me and my pup were fully taken care of before we left. Super affordable also. I was shocked.
Great vet! Very affordable and they're very nice every time we bring our cats. We trust them.
Very thorough Vets. They helped my 15 year old pug with an ear infection
Excellent customer service and friendly staff. I was able to get a walk in for a tech appointment for a nail trim which was quick and efficient. The pricing is affordable. Highly recommend.

First time in this Clinic and it was the worst experience. I brought my dog for a routine Cytopoint shot that he’s received multiple times without any issues. I waited over an hour in the clinic, only to be told they would refuse service unless he wore a muzzle. A muzzle was never brought up when I made the appt and no policy was posted. This was completely unnecessary and felt discriminatory. My dog is a trained and well behaved dog but yet the clinic refused to do their job because they decided to apply that policy to only my dog. None of the other dogs were treated this way.

This experience was frustrating, unfair, and a waste of my time. I will not be returning and will take my dog to a clinic that does not discriminate and that treats dogs evenly.

“I can’t say enough good things about PetCure Veterinary Center. My dog had surgery there, and they took amazing care of her—efficient, kind, and they gave us a fantastic price. I’m so grateful for their professionalism and care. Highly recommend them!”

I’m extremely disappointed with the care my senior pomeranian dog received here. I brought him in for a $79 exam because he was crying out in pain and moving abnormally, and after being told a walk-in after 2 PM was fine, I waited nearly an hour before the vet came in. The exam itself lasted only a couple of minutes, and when I tried to explain that my dog cries when touched and during certain movements, the male vet repeatedly dismissed it as “he’s just old” and even suggested dementia (saying he's just screaming because of dementia not pain), without properly addressing the clear signs of physical pain. No pain management options, treatments, or next steps were discussed, and I left feeling confused and helpless. My dog continued to be in obvious pain afterward, so I called the clinic multiple times asking if anything could be prescribed to help him, and each time I was told someone would call me back with an answer, but no one did. When I finally got a clear answer, I was told I would need to return and pay more for medication that was never discussed during the original visit. Mind you I have to Uber there! On top of that, each receptionist I spoke to was consistently rude and dismissive on the phone, and at one point I was asked why I didn’t request pain medication during the appointment, even though I came in specifically asking what could be done to help my dog and expected the veterinarian to guide that conversation. Is it not the veterinarians job to tell ME what options there are? Like come on? Between the long wait, extremely brief exam, lack of communication, and difficulty getting follow-up help for a dog that is clearly in pain, I feel like I paid a lot and received VERY little actual care or support, and I cannot recommend this clinic based on my experience.
Emily and the Team took care of Black Chyna  and helped her with allergies. Black Chyna and I highly recommend. Affordable prices and great service.
The WHOLE STAFF is AMAZING! This vet clinic really cares about your fur babies - we love the service and care they show… so glad they are close to us. THANK YOU

My dog loves coming here!!
I always have the best experience here and the staff is super awesome!

Excellent service! I’ve brought 3 pets here over the years and I’m always grateful for their kindness, quick service, and professionalism. They’ve elevated my standards for pet care and I highly recommend this vet!

Great staff and very helpful.
I have been coming here for years and very happy with price and services.

I started visiting Pet Cure because of their convenient location and the number of hours they are open. I came for vaccinations but am now a regular!  The staff and doctor are kind and helpful.  They are the best!!
Been coming here with my baby Yorkie Zen since he was just about a month they have taken really good care of him and kept him healthy! Highly recommend!
Great stuff, affordable prices
Great place, kind stuff. Thank you for everything!

We absolutely love PCVC. We have been bringing our dog here for a couple of years now after more than a few horrible experiences at VCA. The staff is always so kind & empathetic. They remember Esteban each time we come in. The vets are always honest, upfront and put our dog first before their profits. The pricing is beyond reasonable which is a major plus! This is the only vets office which Esteban does not become so anxious he shakes uncontrollably. I would & have referred friends, and strangers, to this vet!
Love Pet Cure! They’re very thorough and affordable. They’ve been taking great care of Pitufo for 3 years now.

This is my first time at this vet and they brought me into a room within 15 minutes of my appointment. The staff seem professional and sweet. They were gentle with my cat giving her lots of pets throughout her getting vaccines! 💉 …

Our pup developed hives and welts overnight. We called few vets and no one had appointments. PCVC took walk ins and we rushed there. The whole experience was amazing. From the check in to the doctor’s services! We were seen by Dr. Yosef - a very knowledgeable and caring veterinarian! He gave us a plan, did ultrasound and administered injections. We were in and out for less than 2 hours. Thank you Dr. Yosef and staff!

I’ve been bring my dog here the last 2 years I believe. And they have been quite good with him. The nurses and techs are all very professional and polite. And the doctors are all very informative while being direct. It’s the best vet in the valley!
I absolutely love this center! I had a great experience with them with my first dog so I decided to come back with another dog I purchased. Staff was very nice and they have great prices💜
Very good service pets are accommodated well and customers are satisfied
I have been coming to Pet Cure Veterinary for nearly 2 years. I love the customer service personnel. The clinic is always clean and the ownersp
They take very good care of my baby Blue Rider. My Blue is happy when he comes here and loves everyone here. Thank you.
very welcoming and nice!
Only place I take my cats to
The staff in the clinic are great
I highly recommend this clinic for its nice staff that always here to help .
Thank you very much for your assistance.

I am please to say that this hospital has affable staff and knowledgeable doctors. My regular vet referred me here as they were booked. I wanted my dog seen asap for bloody stools. I called ahead and they told me they could see me as a walk-in for $79 until 5pm. I'm assuming the price goes up after 5pm. I walked in, completed some paperwork and was called to an exam room within 10 mins. Not bad for a walk-in if you ask me! The room was clean and the doctor came in within 10 mins. As for parking,  no issues, the parking lot is huge. I would highly recommend this hospital to anyone who has a furry friend in need.

I had a great experience at this veterinary clinic. The doctor was extremely thorough with the exam and instead of focusing only on the issue we came in for, they took the time to do a full and careful checkup. The vet tech assistant was also wonderful and very skilled at handling my dog, who is usually quite anxious. They kept him calm and comfortable so he could be examined properly. Prices are reasonable as well. I highly recommend this clinic.
Great staff, great atmosphere, short waiting period and verify professional. I was completely satisfied with the services I received.

Honestly, this vet clinic is amazing. They took such good care of my puppy and made the whole experience super smooth. Everyone there was kind, patient, and you can tell they really love what they do. My pup felt comfortable the whole time, and they kept me updated without making anything stressful. If you’re looking for a place that treats your fur baby like family, this is it. Highly recommend! 🐶✨
Came in as a walk in for my dogs flu vaccine and had a short wait time and pleasant interactions with the front desk and nurse. Would recommend!
Very attentive.
We have been bringing our pets here for years. Our doggies have been doing good and we appreciate the prices. They have the best prices for vaccines and the appointment prices are reasonable.
Everyone was very helpful, very reasonable prices and fast paste.
very accommodating to walk in services & clean place!
I really like this place. They’re very sweet to my dog and he felt comfortable here! Will come back again!!!
My first time bringing my puppy here for his vaccines. the staff seems nice and efficient. No appoinment needed. was quick and painless.

Gone several times and never disappointed. Wait times are reasonable and the staff very friendly. They print out a list of recommended services and let you choose without pressuring you to get everything done. Competitively priced and most importantly my pets aren't scarred to go.

I had a great experience at this vet office. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, and they made sure my dog felt comfortable from the moment we arrived. The doctor was also very kind and informative, and was able to provide my dog with relief for his ear infection. Their prices are reasonable compared to other places I’ve been, and the quality of care is excellent. I would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate veterinary team.
Doctor came in promptly and gave many options to help us out with our furry friend. Thank you!
They have been great with everything every time I have been there. Very helpful. Real quality pet care.
Good service
My favorite clinic in the valley. I’ve been bringing both of my cats here for years and they saved my cat from lilies poisoning. So thankful for everything they do for my kitties.
service was good and the workers were friendly. but the main vet was hard to understand due to language barrier. the helper was able to clarify after with the bill.
Close and convenient. Doctor and staff are friendly and helpful and kind to animals. Treated for hyperthyroidism.

They take care of my puppy! Very good price and professional team!
Thank you guys

Saved my dog from a world of discomfort during ‘emergency’ hours without breaking the bank. Staff was incredibly kind and helpful, and both the vet and vet tech were fantastic — super knowledgeable and genuinely caring. 10/10. I’ll absolutely be coming back. THANK YOU!
I was a walk-in and I was seen quickly and I felt that the doctor really cared about helping me. Great place.
The reception and doctors at Pet Cure are so great! Always give my pet so much love and pricing is great too! Highly recommend!
I love this place . I recommend to bring your pet . Very friendly and good service .

I have been coming to this clinic for the past year for my dog and I have been extremely happy with the services provided each an every time! The entire staff is so helpful and answer my questions to the best of their ability to ensure my dog is happy and healthy. Cannot recommend them enough!
My first time bringing my cat to this clinic and the staff is so welcoming and friendly. They provided excellent care. Will come back again.

Took my cats here recently and had a really solid experience. The pricing is competitive, the staff and the doctor are professional, doctor spent a good amount of time listening attentively, everyone who works there handled my cats gently, and everything was done quickly without any unnecessary waiting around. It’s clear they know what they’re doing and keep the process efficient. Overall, a good place to bring your pets if you want reliable care without the inflated costs.

I am incredibly grateful for the amazing care my pet received at this urgent care!  From the moment we walked in, the staff demonstrated genuine kindness and professionalism.

Dr. Faltas was truly outstanding — knowledgeable, compassionate, and patient. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made us feel completely at ease during a stressful situation.

A special shout-out to Kaelob, the assistant, who was exceptionally kind and gentle with my pet. His friendly attitude and calm presence helped both of us feel comforted and well taken care of.

Thank you for going above and beyond — I would highly recommend this clinic to any pet parent seeking top-notch, caring service.

Best place, first time bringing my dog and all staffs are super nice, place is super clean and they attend you very fast. I'm very happy to bring my dog and would recommend. I will definitely keep bringing my dog to this vet.

This is by far the worst veterinary clinic I’ve ever dealt with. I brought my dog here twice for allergy shots, and both times were a complete waste of time and money. NOTHING improved. They just keep charging you without providing any real care or results. It honestly feels like they don’t care about your pet at all — only your wallet. Their service is useless, unprofessional, and a total scam in my opinion. I regret ever trusting them with my dog, and I strongly warn others to stay away.

Had to find a new vet for my cat, and a friend suggested this clinic. I brought him in and  couldn’t be happier with the service! Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. This is now my go to vet for all of my pet’s needs. Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a vet.
Friendly team and quick service took good care of my puppy
Great service for my cat.
Very good helpful great staff. Shows great concern for pets as if they were there own I would highly recommend for any health concerns for your pet

Amazing place to bring your animals with anything that you would need !
You don’t need an appointment just a walk in.

This veterinary clinic delivers outstanding care with a warm, skilled team that truly prioritizes each pet’s health. Whether it’s a routine exam or an unexpected concern, the staff is attentive, gentle, and thorough. The clinic is spotless, well-organized, and equipped with up-to-date technology, which adds to the sense of trust. Communication is excellent, costs are reasonable, and their follow-up support is impressive. They make every visit comfortable and reassuring. A wonderful choice for dependable, compassionate veterinary services.

Close to home! I like how attentive they are, so it's really convenient and comforting to bring my pets here. The staff always takes the time to listen and make sure I understand everything about my pets' care. The clinic feels clean and welcoming, and appointments usually run on time, which I really appreciate. Honestly, if I had known this up front, I doubt I would have gone to them for the other kitten situation.  It’s how you handle a systemic issue that is important.  And this is just a stupid “policy” that a vet would impose.  It does more harm than good systemically. I can assume based on their not wanting to share their spay and neuter price, it isn’t on the cheaper end.  I will write my other review after our last visit with PetCure.

Updated review-I did upgrade the number of stars. I want to give 5 star because what they did for one of the rescue kittens we had was having violent vomitting in large amounts and runny poops. Eventually we were told by another vet to get an ultrasound to see if there is a blockage.  Whihh ch we did at even another specialty vet. They did think there was a blockage but we’re going to charge twice as much as Pet Cure. What makes Pet Curr even more amazing, is that they stayed late to do the surgery.  They took video of his bowels to show me they found no blockage.  They checked his stomach and found no mucus (FIP) and so even though we paid a lot for this surgery to find nothing, we paid at least half as much as the specialty hospital.  The vet and staff were extremely friendly and nice and went above and beyond!  I will return to them even though they were a drive for us.  But worth it for their compassionate care. Just wish they did more to help the issue of the overpopulation of animals in this country!  fYI for the community, there spay and neuter is the most expensive but also isn’t cheap.
